editorialAxis.basis: Actual source front/back plate world-bound centres; this is a presentation axis, not a recovered mate.

presentation.camera: Absolute timeline, tracking before zoom, widening before handing target back; reduced motion uses wide stills and a true settled macro.
presentation.context: Original leaves stay in the scene. Outside-bearing context fades; nonfocus bearing leaves retain at least 0.12 alpha.
presentation.framingEvidence: Source AABB endpoint unions cover authored linear offsets, including base/inspection/rest for the original Part 1. Macro fits that actual bearing component; ghost context may leave frame.
presentation.styleReference: detail/framing.mjs: source-component tracking before zoom; no motor geometry is used

diagnostics.method: 120 Hz finite differences of display translations, excluding camera/opacity, threshold 1e-9 metres/sample.

limitations: Editorial explosion and observation excursion, not collision-checked service disassembly.
Generic Part N names do not establish balls, rollers, races, seals, cages, material, preload or load ratings.
No inferred bearing rotation, contact, joint constraints, force or dynamics.
